summary: Returns the index of a target ID within a 104-entry DWORD array. Reads the object pointer from this+0, obtains the target ID by calling SingleFunctionCallWrapper_a810 with the value stored at obj+0x3FB8, then linearly scans the ID array at obj+0x3E18, returning the index of the first entry equal to the target or -1 when no match is found. Invoked by NetCommPlayerSlotSync (0x0045FC50) to map a queried ID to a player-slot index.

operations.description: Read the object pointer from this+0, read the ID value stored at obj+0x3FB8, and call SingleFunctionCallWrapper_a810 with it; store the returned target ID in targetId.
Initialize matchIndex to 0 before starting the array scan.
Scan the DWORD array starting at obj+0x3E18, comparing each entry against targetId; iteration continues while the current entry does not equal targetId.
Increment matchIndex on each array step; if it reaches 104 (the full array scanned without a match), return -1.
Return matchIndex, the index of the first array entry equal to the target ID, or -1 when no entry matches.

unresolved: The owning class/object is unidentified; only its observable layout is known (ID array at obj+0x3E18, value source at obj+0x3FB8) and that it is called from NetCommPlayerSlotSync.
The meaning of the value passed to SingleFunctionCallWrapper_a810 and of its return (what the target ID represents) is not resolved.
